The '''Soul Sapper Ring''' is a [[Rings|ring]] that can be found in [[Volcano Dungeon]] chests. While wearing it, killing a [[Monsters|monster]] restores 4 [[Energy]].<ref name="effect" />

Equipping a second Soul Sapper Ring causes a further 4 Energy to be gained each time a monster is killed.<ref name="stacking" />

==Dyeing==
It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a green dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==References==
<references>
<ref name="effect">See <samp>Ring::onMonsterSlay</samp> in the game code.</ref>
